title: Internal: Processing Credit Card Account Closures
summary: Provides the internal procedure to process credit card account closures: verify identity, confirm eligibility (balance $0.00, no pending disputes, account age ≥60 days, no pending replacement cards), then run the close_credit_card_account_7834 tool with credit_card_account_id and user_id. Customers receive a confirmation email and final statement within several business days; unredeemed rewards are redeemable for 45 days, and certain annual fees may be fully refunded if closure is within 37 days of the fee charge.
faqs: What are the eligibility requirements to close a credit card account (balance, disputes, account age, replacement cards)?
What steps should support agents follow to process a credit card account closure?
Which tool is used to close the account, and what arguments are required (credit_card_account_id, user_id)?
What post-closure communications will the customer receive and when?
How long do unredeemed rewards remain redeemable after a closure request?
When can an annual fee be fully refunded if a customer closes the account? (37-day window)
